interview.answer: The repair drive time and location haven’t been decided yet.

events.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickup. Do we know where we’re dropping everything off?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: I hear you, Pia. Let’s keep it simple: we’ll confirm the drop-off spot and the pickup person before we move anything.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: That would help a lot. If you send me the address and the pickup contact, I can plan around it.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Great, I’ve got Gus bringing tools and Faye lining up the timing around pickup and drop-off. Eli, send me the times when you have them and I’ll help keep everyone in sync.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Eli: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll send the times once I have them, and let’s confirm the drop-off spot and pickup person first so we keep it simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Jules: Sounds good — let’s lock down the drop-off spot and pickup person, and then I’ll tie the timing in once you send it over.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Eli: Yes, let’s do it that way. I’ll confirm the drop-off spot and pickup contact first, then I’ll send you the address.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help me a lot. Once I have the address and pickup contact, I can work out the timing.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll get those details sorted first and send them over as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: I’ll send the times as soon as I have them, and I’ll keep the plan simple. Just let me know the address and pickup contact when you’ve got them.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Great, I’ll pass that along and get you the address plus pickup contact as soon as I’ve got them.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess. Once you’ve got the address and pickup contact, send them my way and I’ll keep to the plan.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: I’ll send the times as soon as I have them. Once the pickup and drop-off are set, I can keep my part on schedule.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — send the times when you have them, and I’ll pass them around right away. We’ll make sure the repair drive stays on track.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Eli: Absolutely — let’s confirm the drop-off spot and the pickup person first, then we can set the timing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the drop-off spot and pickup details once I have them.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Eli: Good plan, Leo. Once you send those details, I’ll keep the schedule tidy and straightforward.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules — I’ll share the time and place as soon as they’re set. Appreciate you helping keep everyone in the loop.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: Sounds good—just send me the final time, and I’ll fit it around school pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — is that the one you meant?
events.speaker: Eli
